coverage: recorded_arrivals counts all recorded arrival events, including declarations. passive_arrival_events, declaration_events and unclassified_arrival_events partition that total; repeat declarations remain separate events. unique_observed_handles counts only distinct internally linked opted-in passes. These are not unique people, all purpose passes, all HTTP requests or current presence.

notice.text: Your visit time, detector classification and selected purpose are public. If you opt in, your declared name, reason and source category are also public. We keep a handle internally to count purpose passes; that handle is not published. These declarations are not verified identity. Referrer URLs and query strings are not collected automatically, and the raw purpose-pass credential is not added as a generated feed field. All text you enter in name or reason is public. Do not include private information.
